title: State fire marshal; biennial report; deadline; contents.
bodyText:
(a) Beginning with the regular session of 2027, no later than twenty days before the convening in each odd-numbered year of a regular session, the office shall submit to the legislature a report regarding the activities of the state fire marshal and the counties in implementing this chapter.

(b) The report shall include, at a minimum:

(1) A status report concerning:

(A) Community risk reduction; and

(B) The establishment, administration, and enforcement of defensible space requirements;

(2) The amount of moneys expended during the previous fiscal biennium for:

(A) Community risk reduction;

(B) The establishment, administration, and enforcement of defensible space requirements; and

(C) Fire suppression; and

(3) Any recommendations for the state fire marshal for legislative action, including but not limited to current or future resource and funding needs for:

(A) Community risk reduction; and

(B) The establishment, administration, and enforcement of defensible space requirements.
